# Chichester field, "collection from Bognor" in the text

The card's first case (docs/design/modules/pickup-location.md, "Tests and fixtures"; docs/decisions.md, "Where an item really is"). The Chichester page has no point, as in city-pages.seed.json, and the listing has no detail coordinates, so the distance cannot be measured: the text names a place on another page (the seed's Bognor Regis page, matched through its first word), which is a recorded conflict, shown at Bognor Regis, approximate, with "Listed in Chichester".
